reason: I have run my practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp for ten years and am deeply skeptical of paying ₹12,990 upfront for unfamiliar software. For a two-person practice, our free routine works, and I would only ever consider trying the free pilot before paying for any tool.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
would_change_my_mind: Testing the free pilot and seeing it eliminate my two hours of Saturday GST reconciliation while proving that accidental folder moves or deletions in Drive are restored effortlessly.
